title: Globalization and dynamics of social and cultural values
competency: Debate the effect of globalization on culture and respect indigenous knowledge.

keywords.def: The increasing interconnection among people across nations: sharing of information, culture, economic resources and technology.
Promoting and imposing the culture of a powerful nation over a less powerful society.

en.text: Globalization is growing interconnection between people of different nations: sharing information, culture, economic resources and technology. Western entertainment and satellite TV can lead to loss of local identity and cultural imperialism, for example youth dropping Ethiopian clothing for foreign fashion. The youth should be proud of their cultures.

screens.ask: A student in Bahir Dar watches a football match in England live on TV. What does this show?
opts: Globalization: the world is more connected
screens.after: Globalization: information and culture move quickly between nations.

screens.title: Globalization
paras: Globalization is the increasing interconnection among people across nations.
It is a great exchange of information, culture, economic resources and technology.
This leads to strong interdependence among peoples of the world.

screens.title: Effects on culture
paras: The cultural side of globalization is western entertainment and mass media.
Entertainment channels can lead to loss of local identities.
Many youth have left the Ethiopian clothing style for western fashion. This harms the local fashion industry.
The youth should be proud of their cultures.
screens.note: Cultural imperialism: imposing the culture of a powerful nation over a less powerful society.
